context.instruction: Return one action object with a mandatory top-level string field "type": inspect_source, inspect_dependencies or submit. Follow the object examples below; do not return the examples map. Class keys are exact names. Evidence IDs must come from tools. Source actions may optionally add integer start_line and end_line fields. Investigate pending evidence across the ENTIRE state.scope; avoid repeating identical inspections. Every submission must include exactly one record for EVERY scoped class, with required same-class evidence IDs cited. A shared class uses one record with multiple services and does not replace other scoped classes. Never invent evidence or assignments. per_class_progress is refreshed from available evidence; candidate_record_present is not validation or architectural correctness. state.verification_findings are historical findings from the last submission; tools do not update that history. Available evidence must still be cited in the next submission.
context.service_label_rule: Every services value must exactly match an allowed_service_labels entry. Multiple distinct allowed labels require shared=true. Examples are shapes, not class assignments.

context.batch_guidance: Evidence is precollected. Submit all current scoped classes using existing evidence IDs. No further inspections are budgeted. Partial source excerpts are NOT complete files; do not claim unseen code was inspected. Use the SAME global service labels across batches; prior accepted assignments provide context, not reference truth. Shared classes use one row with multiple labels. Allowed literal service labels: ["candidate_1", "candidate_2", "candidate_3", "candidate_4", "candidate_5"]. On unknown_or_duplicate_service findings, repair invalid or repeated labels using only that list; do not repeat the rejected submission unchanged.

model_usage.system_instruction: Return the strict-schema envelope {"action": <one workflow action>}. The mandatory type field belongs to the inner action object. Follow the provided JSON schema and inner action examples. No markdown, hidden reasoning, invented evidence IDs or extra fields. Shared classes use one record with shared=true and multiple services.
model_usage.wire_instruction: Return exactly {"action": <one action object>}. The action examples describe only the inner object. Its mandatory type is inspect_source, inspect_dependencies or submit. Inspection objects contain only type/class and use default source ranges. Use exact class names and real tool evidence IDs; preserve shared-class rules.
